text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, Oguri Cap called me out behind the school building
for some reason, so when I promptly headed over...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So you came.
I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to give you.
...Please accept it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was handed over was chocolate
beautifully wrapped in a transparent bag.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day, isn't it?
So, I tried making some chocolates, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Creek taught me how,
so I think it turned out really delicious.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I got so caught up in trial and error
that it suddenly got this late, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You've taken such good care of me, and I really wanted to express my gratitude to you properly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've received plenty of chocolates
since coming to this academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Being on the giving end
feels this nice, huh.
choice_data_list: But why behind the school building?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Isn't this standard when giving chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, I used to receive chocolates here quite often.
Lately, though, people tend to hand them to me on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Oguri Cap is now adored for her big appetite,
in the beginning, she was someone admired from afar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now, she's become someone who receives overwhelming
support wherever she goes. It's proof that her
popularity across the academy is truly solid.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It is the dorm pantry.
The rest of the chocolate is kept there as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
These chocolates were born from a lot of trial and error.
I must have melted down about twenty kilograms of chocolate bars.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
With this much volume, I couldn't carry it all the way to school.
Don't worry though, I've kept it properly chilled.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is my pride and joy!
I'll eat some too, so let's enjoy them together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Valentine's Day spent with Oguri Cap drew to a close...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No... I just feel somewhat relieved...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"My heart was pounding so hard until you arrived.
It's a little different from when I'm running."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I started wondering if I shouldn't have given more,
and all sorts of thoughts crossed my mind..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"When the chocolates were finished, though,
there was only one person I wanted to give them to."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought so much about you, and packed all those feelings right into these chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... thank you for accepting it,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with a slightly bashful Oguri Cap,
I enjoyed the remaining hours of Valentine's Day...
